description: This file declares functions related to DCA (Data Collection and Analysis) results processing, including functions to get results in JSON and vector formats, string splitting, and error code extraction.

methods.name: getDCAResultsInJson
methods.description: Generates DCA results in JSON format for a given profile, storing the result in grepResultList.

methods.name: getDCAResultsInVector
methods.description: Retrieves DCA results and stores them into a vector structure, with an option to check for rotated data.

methods.name: strSplit
methods.description: Splits a string based on specified delimiters.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Extracts an error code from a string, possibly populating an error code string.
